Fleet Management Fundamentals 01.01 Fleet Management System FMS Architecture Overview A Fleet Management System (FMS) provides the supervisory software layer that coordinates multiple autonomous robots as a unified operational resource. While an individual robot is responsible for localization, perception, navigation, obstacle avoidance, and low-level motion execution, the FMS maintains a fleet-wide view of missions, robot availability, traffic conditions, energy state, faults, and shared resources.

articles.title: What a Mac break timer has to know before it interrupts
articles.excerpt: I built ScreenSky because a break timer that interrupts a call is easy to switch off and forget about. I also wanted a way to pick up my work again after a break. Those turned out to be two separate d…
articles.body: I built ScreenSky because a break timer that interrupts a call is easy to switch off and forget about. I also wanted a way to pick up my work again after a break. Those turned out to be two separate design problems. A break timer has more than one decision to make When a work interval ends, the obvious thing to do is show the break. The harder question is whether now is a good time. ScreenSky has a Smart Pause setting that can hold the timer when the microphone is in use, and you can configure how it behaves around selected apps or other activity. A microphone in use is a useful signal, but it can also mean recording or dictation. Treating that signal as a preference gives users control over which interruptions they want to avoid.
articles.author: unaisshemim

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 02 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_02_Robot_Task_Allocation/16_02_Robot_Task_Allocat…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 02 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_02_Robot_Task_Allocation/16_02_Robot_Task_Allocation_EN.md Volume 16 Multi Robot and Fleet Intelligence 02. Robot Task Allocation 02.01 Task Allocation Problem Formulation MRTA Framework Multi-Robot Task Allocation (MRTA) defines the problem of deciding which robots should perform which tasks, at what time, and under what operational constraints. In a fleet system, allocation sits between mission generation and robot execution. It transforms incoming work orders into robot-task assignments while considering robot capabilities, locations, availability, workload, energy state, task priorities, and environmental conditions.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Multi Robot and Fleet Intelligence — Ch.03: Multi Robot Coordination [EN]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 03 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_03_Multi_Robot_Coordination/16_03_Multi_Robot_Coo…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 03 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_03_Multi_Robot_Coordination/16_03_Multi_Robot_Coordination_EN.md Volume 16 Multi Robot and Fleet Intelligence 03. Multi Robot Coordination 03.01 Multi Robot Coordination Architectures and Patterns Multi-robot coordination defines the mechanisms through which multiple autonomous robots operate as a coherent system rather than as isolated machines. While task allocation determines which robot should perform a task, coordination determines how robots execute their assigned activities without creating conflicts, deadlocks, unsafe interactions, or unnecessary delays.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 04 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_04_Fleet_Communication/16_04_Fleet_Communication_…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 04 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_04_Fleet_Communication/16_04_Fleet_Communication_EN.md Volume 16 Multi Robot and Fleet Intelligence 04. Fleet Communication 04.01 Fleet Communication Protocol Stack MQTT ROS2 REST A fleet communication architecture must support several fundamentally different traffic patterns at the same time. Robots continuously exchange state, commands, mission events, diagnostics, and operational data, while fleet servers communicate with dashboards, enterprise systems, and cloud services. A single protocol rarely satisfies all these requirements efficiently.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 16 · Chapter 05 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_16_Multi_Robot_and_Fleet_Intelligence/blob/main/16_05_Robot_Cloud_Integration/16_05_Robot_Cloud_Inte…

Robot Cloud Integration 05.01 Robot Cloud Integration Architecture Patterns Robot-cloud integration connects autonomous robots operating in physical environments with scalable computing, storage, coordination, and management services outside the robot itself. Within a multi-robot fleet, the cloud should not be treated simply as a remote computer.

Although Xfinity provides its services in the United States, Xbox users were able to take advantage of a loophole that let them change their console's region to New Zealand, allowing them start playing the game early despite their actual geographic location. It's one of the only real notable advantages Xbox has had over PlayStation with this game, as Rockstar secured a marketing deal to advertise GTA 6 as playing best on PS5. However, these hours of early access have proven to be very lucrative for Xbox players.

articles.body: Rockstar Games has revealed why they chose to forego the ability to pick up prostitutes in GTA 6 . That's right — GTA 6 doesn't let you pick up ladies of the night when you're feeling lonely anymore. No, the reason isn't because the game has "gone woke" or anything like that; instead, it's for narrative purposes. As you may already know, Rockstar has put the focus of GTA 6 on a couple. The entire story largely hinges on the romantic pair at the very least having an interest of pursuing a relationship with each other, if not being madly in love, should the player take them down that road. articles.title: Astronomers witness a star eating its companion in 1st-of-its-kind observation
articles.excerpt: Astronomers may have, for the first time ever, directly witnessed a star engulfing its stellar companion.
articles.body: Astronomers may have, for the first time ever, directly witnessed a star engulfing its companion, a new study reports. As stars die, they swell up to hundreds of times their original size, consuming anything orbiting nearby. In a binary star system, this can include a dying star merging with its companion star. However, scientists had never directly seen any examples of such a cosmic drama unfolding — until now. "Catching a star engulfing its companion in the act is very difficult," study lead author Viraj Karambelkar, an astrophysicist at Columbia University in New York, told Space.com. "When a star engulfs its companion, its effect is very subtle — like throwing a bucket of water in a large ocean.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 18, 2013: NASA launches MAVEN spacecraft to Mars to find out how the Red Planet lost its water
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 18, 2013, NASA launched the MAVEN spacecraft to Mars to investigate the planet's missing water. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 18, 2013, NASA launched the MAVEN spacecraft to Mars. The name of NASA's MAVEN spacecraft stands for Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN. The spacecraft was an orbiter designed to help scientists figure out what happened to the water on Mars and its atmosphere. Mars is dry today, but it data from several Mars missions suggest that it was a much wetter environment a long time ago. MAVEN tracked the rate of atmospheric loss from Mars . The planet has a super thin atmosphere that has been leaking into space for a few billion years. Scientists think that when Mars lost its atmosphere, water dried up on the surface as a result. Solar storms that blast radiation into the solar system appear to have blasted away some of the atmosphere.
